        <div class="td-content">
           <h1 id="mesheryctl-model-build">mesheryctl model build</h1>

<p>Create an OCI-compliant package from the model files</p>

<h2 id="synopsis">Synopsis</h2>

<p>Create an OCI-compliant package from the model files.
Model files are taken from [path]/[model-name]/[model-version] folder.
Expects input to be in the format scaffolded by the model init command.</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl model build [flags]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="examples">Examples</h2>

<p>Create an OCI-compliant package from the model files</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl model build [model-name]

</div>
</pre>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl model build [model-name]/[model-version]

</div>
</pre>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
    

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options">Options</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
  -h, --help          help for build
  -p, --path string   (optional) target directory to get model from (default: current dir) (default ".")

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">Options inherited from parent commands</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="see-also">See Also</h2>

<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.8/project/contributing/contributing-cli#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>
   <br/>

              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];

          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1 id="mesheryctl-model-delete">mesheryctl model delete</h1>

<p>Delete a model</p>

<h2 id="synopsis">Synopsis</h2>

<p>Delete a model by ID or Name</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl model delete [model-id | model-name] [flags]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="examples">Examples</h2>

<p>Delete a model by ID</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl model delete [model-id]

</div>
</pre>

<p>Delete a model by name</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl model delete [model-name]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options">Options</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
  -h, --help   help for delete

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">Options inherited from parent commands</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="see-also">See Also</h2>

<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.8/project/contributing/contributing-cli#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>

          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');

          }

     $('#stars').text(stars + " Stars")
     $('#forks').text(forks + " Forks")
  });
});
</script>
meshery-custom-end -->

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1 id="mesheryctl-model-export">mesheryctl model export</h1>

<p>Export registered models</p>

<h2 id="synopsis">Synopsis</h2>

<p>Export the registered model to the specified output type</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl model export [flags]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="examples">Examples</h2>

<p>Export a model by name</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl model export [model-name] -o [oci|tar]  (default is oci)

</div>
</pre>

<p>Export a model by name in JSON type</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl model export [model-name] -t [yaml|json] (default is YAML)

</div>
</pre>

<p>Export a model by name in YAML type in a specific location</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl model export [model-name] -l [path-to-location]

</div>
</pre>

<p>Export a model by name in YAML type discarding components and relationships</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl model export [model-name] --discard-components --discard-relationships

</div>
</pre>

<p>Export a model version by name in YAML type</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl model export [model-name] --version [version (ex: v0.7.3)]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options">Options</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
  -c, --discard-components       (optional) whether to discard components in the exported model definition (default = false)
  -r, --discard-relationships    (optional) whether to discard relationships in the exported model definition (default = false)
  -h, --help                     help for export
  -t, --output-format string     (optional) format to display in [json|yaml] (default = yaml) (default "yaml")
  -l, --output-location string   (optional) output location (default = current directory) (default "./")
  -o, --output-type string       (optional) format to display in [oci|tar] (default = oci) (default "oci")
  -p, --page int                 (optional) page number for paginated results (default = 1) (default 1)
      --version string           (optional) model version to export (default = "", format: vX.X.X)

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">Options inherited from parent commands</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="see-also">See Also</h2>

<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.8/project/contributing/contributing-cli#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>
   <br/>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1 id="mesheryctl-model-generate">mesheryctl model generate</h1>

<p>Generate models from a file</p>

<h2 id="synopsis">Synopsis</h2>

<p>Generate models by specifying the directory, file, or URL. You can also provide a template JSON file and registrant name</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl model generate [flags]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="examples">Examples</h2>

<p>Generate a model from a CSV file(s)</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl model generate --f [path-to-csv-drectory]

</div>
</pre>

<p>Generate a model from a Uri baesd on a JSON template</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl model generate --f [URL] -t [path-to-template.json]

</div>
</pre>

<p>Generate a model from a Uri baesd on a JSON template skipping registration</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl model generate --f [URL] -t [path-to-template.json] -r

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options">Options</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
  -f, --file string       Specify path to the file or directory
  -h, --help              help for generate
  -r, --register          Skip registration of the model
  -t, --template string   Specify path to the template JSON file

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">Options inherited from parent commands</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="see-also">See Also</h2>

<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.8/project/contributing/contributing-cli#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1 id="mesheryctl-model-import">mesheryctl model import</h1>

<p>Import models</p>

<h2 id="synopsis">Synopsis</h2>

<p>Import models by specifying the directory, file, or URL. You can also provide a template JSON file and registrant name</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl model import [flags]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="examples">Examples</h2>

<p>Import model</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl model import -f [URI]

</div>
</pre>

<p>Import model from a URL to a meshery model</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl model import -f [URL]

</div>
</pre>

<p>Import model from an OCI artifact</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl model import -f [OCI]

</div>
</pre>

<p>Import model from a tar.gz file</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl model import -f [path-to-model.tar.gz]

</div>
</pre>

<p>Import model from a path</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl model import -f [path-to-model]

</div>
</pre>

<p>Import model using CSV files</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl model import -f [path-to-csv-directory]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options">Options</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
  -f, --file string   Specify path to the file or directory
  -h, --help          help for import

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">Options inherited from parent commands</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="see-also">See Also</h2>

<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.8/project/contributing/contributing-cli#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>
   <br/>

$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });

<!-- <a href="http://idratherbewriting.com" class="noCrossRef productSubtitle"> Home </a> > <a class="noCrossRef productSubtitle" href="https://docs.meshery.io">Learn API Doc</a> > mesheryctl-model -->

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1 id="mesheryctl-model">mesheryctl model</h1>

<p>Manage models in the registery</p>

<h2 id="synopsis">Synopsis</h2>

<p>Export, generate, import, list, search and view model(s) and detailed informations</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl model [flags]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="examples">Examples</h2>

<p>Display number of available models in Meshery</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl model --count

</div>
</pre>

<p>Export registred models</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl model export [model-name]

</div>
</pre>

<p>Generate model(s)</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl model export [model-name]

</div>
</pre>

<p>Import model(s)</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl model import -f [Uri]

</div>
</pre>

<p>List available model(s)</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl model list

</div>
</pre>

<p>Delete avaialbe model(s)</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl model delete [model-id]

</div>
</pre>

<p>Search for a specific model</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl model search [model-name]

</div>
</pre>

<p>View a specific model</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl model view [model-name]

</div>
</pre>

<p>Scaffold a folder structure for model creation</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl model init [model-name]

</div>
</pre>

<p>Create an OCI-compliant package from the model files</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl model build [model-name]

</div>
</pre>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl model build [model-name]/[model-version]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options">Options</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
      --count   (optional) Get the number of models in total
  -h, --help    help for model

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">Options inherited from parent commands</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>

$(document).ready(function() {

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1 id="mesheryctl-model-init">mesheryctl model init</h1>

<p>Generates scaffolding for convenient model creation</p>

<h2 id="synopsis">Synopsis</h2>

<p>Generates a folder structure and guides user on model creation</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl model init [flags]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="examples">Examples</h2>

<p>generates a folder structure</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl model init [model-name]

</div>
</pre>

<p>generates a folder structure and sets up model version</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl model init [model-name] --version [version] (default is v0.1.0)

</div>
</pre>

<p>generates a folder structure under specified path</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl model init [model-name] --path [path-to-location] (default is current folder)

</div>
</pre>

<p>generate a folder structure in json format</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl model init [model-name] --output-format [json|yaml|csv] (default is json)

</div>
</pre>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
    

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options">Options</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
  -h, --help                   help for init
  -o, --output-format string   (optional) format to display in [json|yaml] (default "json")
  -p, --path string            (optional) target directory (default: current dir) (default ".")
      --version string         (optional) model version (default: v0.1.0) (default "v0.1.0")

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">Options inherited from parent commands</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="see-also">See Also</h2>

<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.8/project/contributing/contributing-cli#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1 id="mesheryctl-model-list">mesheryctl model list</h1>

<p>List registered models</p>

<h2 id="synopsis">Synopsis</h2>

<p>List all registered models by pagingation (25 models per page)</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl model list [flags]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="examples">Examples</h2>

<p>List of models</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl model list

</div>
</pre>

<p>List of models for a specified page</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl model list --page [page-number]

</div>
</pre>

<p>Display number of available models in Meshery</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl model list --count

</div>
</pre>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
    

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options">Options</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
  -c, --count          (optional) Get the number of models in total
  -h, --help           help for list
  -p, --page int       (optional) List next set of models with --page (default = 0) (default 1)
  -s, --pagesize int   (optional) List next set of models with --pagesize (default = 0)

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">Options inherited from parent commands</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1 id="mesheryctl-model-search">mesheryctl model search</h1>

<p>Search model(s)</p>

<h2 id="synopsis">Synopsis</h2>

<p>Search model(s) by search string</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl model search [flags]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="examples">Examples</h2>

<p>Search model from current provider</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl model search [query-text]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options">Options</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
  -h, --help   help for search

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">Options inherited from parent commands</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="see-also">See Also</h2>

<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.8/project/contributing/contributing-cli#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>
   <br/>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1 id="mesheryctl-model-view">mesheryctl model view</h1>

<p>View model</p>

<h2 id="synopsis">Synopsis</h2>

<p>View a model queried by its name</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl model view [flags]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="examples">Examples</h2>

<p>View a specific model from current provider</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl model view [model-name]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options">Options</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
  -h, --help                   help for view
  -o, --output-format string   (optional) format to display in [json|yaml] (default "yaml")

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">Options inherited from parent commands</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="see-also">See Also</h2>

<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.8/project/contributing/contributing-cli#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>
   <br/>


        </div>
      </main>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1 id="mesheryctl-organization">mesheryctl organization</h1>

<p>Interact with registered organizations</p>

<h2 id="synopsis">Synopsis</h2>

<p>Interact with registered organizations to display detailed information</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl organization [flags]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="examples">Examples</h2>

<p>Number of  registered orgs</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl organization --count

</div>
</pre>

<p>List registerd orgs</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl organization list

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options">Options</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
      --count   total number of registered organizations
  -h, --help    help for organization

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">Options inherited from parent commands</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="see-also">See Also</h2>

<ul>
  <li><a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/organization/list">mesheryctl organization list</a></li>
</ul>

<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.8/project/contributing/contributing-cli#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>
   <br/>

     $('#stars').text(stars + " Stars")
     $('#forks').text(forks + " Forks")
  });
});
</script>
meshery-custom-end -->

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1 id="mesheryctl-organization-list">mesheryctl organization list</h1>

<p>List registered organizations</p>

<h2 id="synopsis">Synopsis</h2>

<p>List all registered organizations with their id, name and date of creation. Organization will be returned based on provider you logged in.</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl organization list [flags]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="examples">Examples</h2>

<p>list all organizations</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl organization list

</div>
</pre>

<p>list organizations for a specified page</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl organization list --page [page-number]

</div>
</pre>

<p>Display number of available organizations</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl organization list --count

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options">Options</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
      --count          total number of registered orgs
  -h, --help           help for list
  -p, --page int       (optional) Page number of paginated results (default 1)
  -s, --pagesize int   (optional) Number of organizations per page (default 10)

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">Options inherited from parent commands</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="see-also">See Also</h2>

<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.8/project/contributing/contributing-cli#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>
   <br/>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1 id="mesheryctl-perf-apply">mesheryctl perf apply</h1>

<p>Run a Performance test</p>

<h2 id="synopsis">Synopsis</h2>

<p>Run Performance test using existing profiles or using flags</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl perf apply [profile-name] [flags]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="examples">Examples</h2>

<p>Execute a Performance test with the specified performance profile</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl perf apply meshery-profile [flags]

</div>
</pre>

<p>Execute a Performance test with creating a new performance profile</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl perf apply meshery-profile-new --url "https://google.com"

</div>
</pre>

<p>Execute a Performance test creating a new performance profile and pass certificate to be used</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl perf apply meshery-profile-new --url "https://google.com" --cert-path path/to/cert.pem

</div>
</pre>

<p>Execute a performance profile without using the certificate present in the profile</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl perf apply meshery-profile --url "https://google.com" --disable-cert

</div>
</pre>

<p>Run Performance test using SMP compatible test configuration
If the profile already exists, the test will be run overriding the values with the ones provided in the configuration file</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl perf apply meshery-profile -f path/to/perf-config.yaml

</div>
</pre>

<p>Run performance test using SMP compatible test configuration and override values with flags</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl perf apply meshery-profile -f path/to/perf-config.yaml [flags]

</div>
</pre>

<p>Choice of load generator - fortio, wrk2 or nighthawk (default: fortio)</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl perf apply meshery-profile --load-generator wrk2

</div>
</pre>

<p>Execute a Performance test with specified queries per second</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl perf apply meshery-profile --url https://192.168.1.15/productpage --qps 30

</div>
</pre>

<p>Execute a Performance test with specified infrastructure</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl perf apply meshery-profile --url https://192.168.1.15/productpage --mesh istio

</div>
</pre>

<p>Execute a Performance test creating a new performance profile and pass options to the load generator used
If any options are already present in the profile or passed through flags, the –options flag will take precedence over the profile and flag options
Options for nighthawk - https://github.com/meshery-extensions/getnighthawk/blob/v1.0.5/pkg/proto/options.pb.go#L882-L1018
Options for fortio - https://github.com/fortio/fortio/blob/v1.57.0/fhttp/httprunner.go#L77-L84
Options for wrk2 - https://github.com/meshery-extensions/gowrk2/blob/v0.6.1/api/gowrk2.go#L47-L53</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl perf apply meshery-profile-new --url "https://google.com" --options [filepath|json-string]

</div>
</pre>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl perf apply meshery-profile-new --url "https://google.com" --options path/to/options.json

</div>
</pre>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl perf apply meshery-profile-new --url "https://google.com" --load-generator nighthawk --options '{"requests_per_second": 10, "max_pending_requests": 5}'

</div>
</pre>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl perf apply meshery-profile-new --url "https://google.com" --load-generator fortio --options '{"MethodOverride": "POST"}'

</div>
</pre>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl perf apply meshery-profile-new --url "https://google.com" --load-generator wrk2 --options '{"DurationInSeconds": 15, "Thread": 3}'

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options">Options</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
  -b, --body string                  (optional) Load test body. Can be a filepath/string
      --cert-path string             (optional) Path to the certificate to be used for the load test
      --concurrent-requests string   (optional) Number of Parallel Requests
      --disable-cert                 (optional) Do not use certificate present in the profile
      --duration string              (optional) Length of test (e.g. 10s, 5m, 2h). For more, see https://golang.org/pkg/time/#ParseDuration
  -f, --file string                  (optional) File containing SMP-compatible test configuration. For more, see https://github.com/service-mesh-performance/service-mesh-performance-specification
  -h, --help                         help for apply
      --load-generator string        (optional) Load-Generator to be used (fortio/wrk2/nighthawk)
      --mesh string                  (optional) Name of the infrastructure
      --name string                  (optional) Name of the Test
      --options string               (optional) Additional options to be passed to the load generator. Can be a json string or a filepath containing json
      --qps string                   (optional) Queries per second
      --url string                   (optional) Endpoint URL to test (required with --profile)

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">Options inherited from parent commands</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
      --config string          path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -o, --output-format string   (optional) format to display in [json|yaml]
  -t, --token string           (required) Path to meshery auth config
  -v, --verbose                verbose output
  -y, --yes                    (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="screenshots">Screenshots</h2>

<p>Usage of mesheryctl perf apply
<img src="/v0.8/assets/img/mesheryctl/perf-apply.png" alt="perf-apply-usage" /></p>

<h2 id="see-also">See Also</h2>

<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.8/project/contributing/contributing-cli#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1 id="mesheryctl-perf">mesheryctl perf</h1>

<p>Run performance tests</p>

<h2 id="synopsis">Synopsis</h2>

<p>Load generation and performance characterization</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl perf [flags]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="examples">Examples</h2>

<p>Run performance test:</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl perf apply test-3 --name "a quick stress test" --url http://192.168.1.15/productpage --qps 300 --concurrent-requests 2 --duration 30s

</div>
</pre>

<p>List performance profiles:</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl perf profile sam-test

</div>
</pre>

<p>List performance results:</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl perf result sam-test

</div>
</pre>

<p>Display Perf profile in JSON or YAML:</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl perf result -o json

</div>
</pre>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl perf result -o yaml

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options">Options</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
  -h, --help                   help for perf
  -o, --output-format string   (optional) format to display in [json|yaml]
  -t, --token string           (required) Path to meshery auth config
  -y, --yes                    (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">Options inherited from parent commands</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="see-also">See Also</h2>

<ul>
  <li><a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/perf/apply">mesheryctl perf apply</a></li>
  <li><a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/perf/profile">mesheryctl perf profile</a></li>
  <li><a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/perf/result">mesheryctl perf result</a></li>
</ul>

<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.8/project/contributing/contributing-cli#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>
   <br/>

$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1 id="mesheryctl-perf-profile">mesheryctl perf profile</h1>

<p>List performance profiles</p>

<h2 id="synopsis">Synopsis</h2>

<p>List all the available performance profiles</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl perf profile [profile-name] [flags]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="examples">Examples</h2>

<p>List performance profiles (maximum 25 profiles)</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl perf profile

</div>
</pre>

<p>List performance profiles with search (maximum 25 profiles)</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl perf profile test 2

</div>
</pre>

<p>View single performance profile with detailed information</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl perf profile test --view

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options">Options</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
  -h, --help       help for profile
  -p, --page int   (optional) List next set of performance results with --page (default = 1) (default 1)
      --view       (optional) View single performance profile with more info

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">Options inherited from parent commands</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
      --config string          path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -o, --output-format string   (optional) format to display in [json|yaml]
  -t, --token string           (required) Path to meshery auth config
  -v, --verbose                verbose output
  -y, --yes                    (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="see-also">See Also</h2>

<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.8/project/contributing/contributing-cli#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>
   <br/>

          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {

              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1 id="mesheryctl-perf-result">mesheryctl perf result</h1>

<p>List performance test results</p>

<h2 id="synopsis">Synopsis</h2>

<p>List all the available test results of a performance profile</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl perf result [profile-name] [flags]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="examples">Examples</h2>

<p>List Test results (maximum 25 results)</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl perf result saturday-profile

</div>
</pre>

<p>View other set of performance results with –page (maximum 25 results)</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl perf result saturday-profile --page 2

</div>
</pre>

<p>View single performance result with detailed information</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl perf result saturday-profile --view

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options">Options</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
  -h, --help       help for result
  -p, --page int   (optional) List next set of performance results with --page (default = 1) (default 1)
      --view       (optional) View single performance results with more info

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">Options inherited from parent commands</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
      --config string          path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -o, --output-format string   (optional) format to display in [json|yaml]
  -t, --token string           (required) Path to meshery auth config
  -v, --verbose                verbose output
  -y, --yes                    (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="screenshots">Screenshots</h2>

<p>Usage of mesheryctl perf result
<img src="/v0.8/assets/img/mesheryctl/perf-result.png" alt="perf-result-usage" /></p>

<h2 id="see-also">See Also</h2>

<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.8/project/contributing/contributing-cli#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>
   <br/>

$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })

        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1 id="mesheryctl-registry-generate">mesheryctl registry generate</h1>

<p>Generate Models</p>

<h2 id="synopsis">Synopsis</h2>

<p>Prerequisite: Excecute this command from the root of a meshery/meshery repo fork.\n\nGiven a Google Sheet with a list of model names and source locations, generate models and components any Registrant (e.g. GitHub, Artifact Hub) repositories.\n\nGenerated Model files are written to local filesystem under “/server/models/<model-name>".</model-name></p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl registry generate [flags]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="examples">Examples</h2>

<p>Generate Meshery Models from a Google Spreadsheet (i.e. “Meshery Integrations” spreadsheet).</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl registry generate --spreadsheet-id "1DZHnzxYWOlJ69Oguz4LkRVTFM79kC2tuvdwizOJmeMw" --spreadsheet-cred "$CRED"

</div>
</pre>

<p>Directly generate models from one of the supported registrants by using Registrant Connection Definition and (optional) Registrant Credential Definition</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl registry generate --registrant-def [path to connection definition] --registrant-cred [path to credential definition]

</div>
</pre>

<p>Generate a specific Model from a Google Spreadsheet (i.e. “Meshery Integrations” spreadsheet).</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl registry generate --spreadsheet-id "1DZHnzxYWOlJ69Oguz4LkRVTFM79kC2tuvdwizOJmeMw" --spreadsheet-cred --model "[model-name]"

</div>
</pre>

<p>Generate Meshery Models and Component from csv files in a local directory.</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl registry generate --directory [DIRECTORY_PATH]

</div>
</pre>

<p>Generate Meshery Models from individual CSV files.</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl registry generate --model-csv [path/to/models.csv] --component-csv [path/to/components.csv] --relationship-csv [path/to/relationships.csv]

</div>
</pre>

<p>Generate models with a custom per-model timeout (e.g., 10 minutes per model).</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl registry generate --spreadsheet-id "1DZHnzxYWOlJ69Oguz4LkRVTFM79kC2tuvdwizOJmeMw" --spreadsheet-cred "$CRED" --timeout 10m

</div>
</pre>

<p>Generate only the latest version of each model.</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl registry generate --spreadsheet-id "1DZHnzxYWOlJ69Oguz4LkRVTFM79kC2tuvdwizOJmeMw" --spreadsheet-cred "$CRED" --latest-only

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options">Options</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
      --component-csv string      path to the component CSV file
  -d, --directory string          Directory containing the Model and Component CSV files
  -h, --help                      help for generate
      --latest-only               generate only the latest version of each model
  -m, --model string              specific model name to be generated
      --model-csv string          path to the model CSV file
  -o, --output string             location to output generated models, defaults to ../server/meshmodels (default "../server/meshmodel")
      --registrant-cred string    path pointing to the registrant credential definition
      --registrant-def string     path pointing to the registrant connection definition
      --relationship-csv string   path to the relationship CSV file (optional)
      --spreadsheet-cred string   base64 encoded credential to download the spreadsheet
      --spreadsheet-id string     spreadsheet ID for the integration spreadsheet
      --timeout duration          timeout duration for generating each model (e.g., 5m, 10m, 1h), default: 5m (default 5m0s)

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">Options inherited from parent commands</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="see-also">See Also</h2>

<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.8/project/contributing/contributing-cli#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>

            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){

              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');

          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1 id="mesheryctl-registry">mesheryctl registry</h1>

<p>Manage the capability registry</p>

<h2 id="synopsis">Synopsis</h2>

<p>Manage the state and contents of Meshery’s internal registry of capabilities.</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl registry [flags]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="examples">Examples</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl registry [subcommand]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options">Options</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
  -h, --help   help for registry

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">Options inherited from parent commands</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="see-also">See Also</h2>

<ul>
  <li><a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/registry/generate">mesheryctl registry generate</a></li>
  <li><a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/registry/publish">mesheryctl registry publish</a></li>
  <li><a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/registry/update">mesheryctl registry update</a></li>
</ul>

<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.8/project/contributing/contributing-cli#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>
   <br/>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1 id="mesheryctl-registry-publish">mesheryctl registry publish</h1>

<p>Publish Meshery Models to Websites, Remote Provider, Meshery Server</p>

<h2 id="synopsis">Synopsis</h2>

<p>Publishes metadata about Meshery Models to Websites, Remote Provider, or Meshery Server, including model and component icons by reading from a Google Spreadsheet and outputing to markdown or json format.</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl registry publish [system] [google-sheet-credential] [sheet-id] [models-output-path] [imgs-output-path] [flags]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="examples">Examples</h2>

<p>Publish To System</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl registry publish [system] [google-sheet-credential] [sheet-id] [models-output-path] [imgs-output-path] -o [output-format]

</div>
</pre>

<p>Publish To Meshery</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl registry publish meshery GoogleCredential GoogleSheetID [repo]/server/meshmodel

</div>
</pre>

<p>Publish To Remote Provider</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl registry publish remote-provider GoogleCredential GoogleSheetID [repo]/meshmodels/models [repo]/ui/public/img/meshmodels

</div>
</pre>

<p>Publish To Website</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl registry publish website GoogleCredential GoogleSheetID [repo]/integrations [repo]/ui/public/img/meshmodels

</div>
</pre>

<p>Publishing to meshery docs</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
cd docs;

</div>
</pre>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl registry publish website "$CRED" 1DZHnzxYWOlJ69Oguz4LkRVTFM79kC2tuvdwizOJmeMw docs/pages/integrations docs/assets/img/integrations -o md

</div>
</pre>

<p>Publishing to mesheryio site</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl registry publish website "$CRED" 1DZHnzxYWOlJ69Oguz4LkRVTFM79kC2tuvdwizOJmeMw meshery.io/integrations meshery.io/assets/images/integration -o js

</div>
</pre>

<p>Publishing to any website</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl registry publish website "$CRED" 1DZHnzxYWOlJ69Oguz4LkRVTFM79kC2tuvdwizOJmeMw path/to/models path/to/icons -o mdx

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options">Options</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
  -h, --help                   help for publish
  -o, --output-format string   output format [md | mdx | js]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">Options inherited from parent commands</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="see-also">See Also</h2>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>
