        <div class="td-content">
           <h1 id="mesheryctl-registry-update">mesheryctl registry update</h1>

<p>Update the registry with latest data.</p>

<h2 id="synopsis">Synopsis</h2>

<p>Updates the component metadata (SVGs, shapes, styles and other) by referring from a Google Spreadsheet.</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl registry update [flags]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="examples">Examples</h2>

<p>Update models from Meshery Integration Spreadsheet</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl registry update --spreadsheet-id [id] --spreadsheet-cred "$CRED" -i [path to the directory containing models].

</div>
</pre>

<p>Updating models in the meshery/meshery repository based on the spreadsheet</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl registry update --spreadsheet-id 1DZHnzxYWOlJ69Oguz4LkRVTFM79kC2tuvdwizOJmeMw --spreadsheet-cred "$CRED"

</div>
</pre>

<p>Updating models in the meshery/meshery repository based on flag</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl registry update --spreadsheet-id 1DZHnzxYWOlJ69Oguz4LkRVTFM79kC2tuvdwizOJmeMw --spreadsheet-cred "$CRED" --model "[model-name]"

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options">Options</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
  -h, --help                      help for update
  -i, --input string              relative or absolute input path to the models directory (default "../server/meshmodel")
  -m, --model string              specific model name to be generated
      --spreadsheet-cred string   base64 encoded credential to download the spreadsheet
      --spreadsheet-id string     spreadsheet it for the integration spreadsheet

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">Options inherited from parent commands</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="see-also">See Also</h2>

<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.8/project/contributing/contributing-cli#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>
   <br/>

<!-- <a href="http://idratherbewriting.com" class="noCrossRef productSubtitle"> Home </a> > <a class="noCrossRef productSubtitle" href="https://docs.meshery.io">Learn API Doc</a> > mesheryctl-system-channel -->

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1 id="mesheryctl-system-channel">mesheryctl system channel</h1>

<p>Switch between release channels</p>

<h2 id="synopsis">Synopsis</h2>

<p>Subscribe to a release channel. Choose between either ‘stable’ or ‘edge’ channels.</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system channel [flags]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="examples">Examples</h2>

<p>Subscribe to release channel or version</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system channel

</div>
</pre>

<p>To set the channel</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system channel set [stable|stable-version|edge|edge-version]

</div>
</pre>

<p>To pin/set the channel to a specific version</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system channel set stable-v0.6.0

</div>
</pre>

<p>To view release channel and version</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system channel view

</div>
</pre>

<p>To switch release channel and version</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system channel switch [stable|stable-version|edge|edge-version]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options">Options</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
  -h, --help   help for channel

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">Options inherited from parent commands</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
      --config string    path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -c, --context string   (optional) temporarily change the current context.
  -v, --verbose          verbose output
  -y, --yes              (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.

</div>
</pre>

<ul>

</ul>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1 id="mesheryctl-system-channel-set">mesheryctl system channel set</h1>

<p>set release channel and version</p>

<h2 id="synopsis">Synopsis</h2>

<p>Set release channel and version of context in focus</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system channel set [stable|stable-version|edge|edge-version] [flags]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="examples">Examples</h2>

<p>Subscribe to release channel or version</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system channel set [stable|stable-version|edge|edge-version]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options">Options</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
  -h, --help   help for set

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">Options inherited from parent commands</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
      --config string    path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -c, --context string   (optional) temporarily change the current context.
  -v, --verbose          verbose output
  -y, --yes              (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="see-also">See Also</h2>

<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.8/project/contributing/contributing-cli#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>
   <br/>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1 id="mesheryctl-system-channel-switch">mesheryctl system channel switch</h1>

<p>switch release channel and version</p>

<h2 id="synopsis">Synopsis</h2>

<p>Switch release channel and version of context in focus</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system channel switch [stable|stable-version|edge|edge-version] [flags]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="examples">Examples</h2>

<p>Switch between release channels</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system channel switch [stable|stable-version|edge|edge-version]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options">Options</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
  -h, --help   help for switch

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">Options inherited from parent commands</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
      --config string    path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -c, --context string   (optional) temporarily change the current context.
  -v, --verbose          verbose output
  -y, --yes              (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="see-also">See Also</h2>

<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.8/project/contributing/contributing-cli#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>
   <br/>


        </div>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1 id="mesheryctl-system-channel-view">mesheryctl system channel view</h1>

<p>view release channel and version</p>

<h2 id="synopsis">Synopsis</h2>

<p>View release channel and version of context in focus</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system channel view [flags]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="examples">Examples</h2>

<p>View current release channel</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system channel view

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options">Options</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
  -a, --all    Show release channel for all contexts
  -h, --help   help for view

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">Options inherited from parent commands</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
      --config string    path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -c, --context string   (optional) temporarily change the current context.
  -v, --verbose          verbose output
  -y, --yes              (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="see-also">See Also</h2>

<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.8/project/contributing/contributing-cli#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>
   <br/>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1 id="mesheryctl-system-check">mesheryctl system check</h1>

<p>Pre-deployment and post-deployment healthchecks for Meshery</p>

<h2 id="synopsis">Synopsis</h2>

<p>Verify environment pre/post-deployment of Meshery.</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system check [flags]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="examples">Examples</h2>

<p>Run all system checks for both pre and post-deployment scenarios</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system check

</div>
</pre>

<p>Run pre-deployment checks (Docker and Kubernetes)</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system check --preflight

</div>
</pre>

<p>Run pre-deployment checks (Docker and Kubernetes)</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system check --pre

</div>
</pre>

<p>Run checks for all Meshery adapters</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system check --adapters

</div>
</pre>

<p>Run checks on a specific Meshery adapter</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system check --adapter meshery-istio:10000

</div>
</pre>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system check --adapter meshery-istio

</div>
</pre>

<p>Verify the health of Meshery Operator’s deployment with MeshSync and Broker</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system check --operator

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options">Options</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
      --adapter string   Check status of specified meshery adapter
      --adapters         Check status of meshery adapters
      --components       Check status of Meshery components
  -h, --help             help for check
      --operator         Verify the health of Meshery Operator's deployment with MeshSync and Broker
      --pre              Verify environment readiness to deploy Meshery
      --preflight        Verify environment readiness to deploy Meshery

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">Options inherited from parent commands</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
      --config string    path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -c, --context string   (optional) temporarily change the current context.
  -v, --verbose          verbose output
  -y, --yes              (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="screenshots">Screenshots</h2>

<p>Usage of mesheryctl system check
<img src="/v0.8/assets/img/mesheryctl/check.png" alt="check-usage" /></p>

<h2 id="see-also">See Also</h2>

<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.8/project/contributing/contributing-cli#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>

$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1 id="mesheryctl-system-context-create">mesheryctl system context create</h1>

<p>Create a new context (a named Meshery deployment)</p>

<h2 id="synopsis">Synopsis</h2>

<p>Add a new context to Meshery config.yaml file</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system context create context-name [flags]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="examples">Examples</h2>

<p>Create new context</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system context create [context-name]

</div>
</pre>

<p>Create new context and provide list of components, platform &amp; URL</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system context create context-name --components meshery-nsm --platform docker --url http://localhost:9081 --set --yes

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options">Options</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
  -a, --components stringArray   List of components
  -h, --help                     help for create
  -p, --platform string          Platform to deploy Meshery
      --provider string          Provider to use with the Meshery server
  -s, --set                      Set as current context
  -u, --url string               Meshery Server URL with Port

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">Options inherited from parent commands</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
      --config string    path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -c, --context string   (optional) temporarily change the current context.
  -v, --verbose          verbose output
  -y, --yes              (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="screenshots">Screenshots</h2>

<p>Usage of mesheryctl context create
<img src="/v0.8/assets/img/mesheryctl/newcontext.png" alt="context-create-usage" /></p>

<h2 id="see-also">See Also</h2>

<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.8/project/contributing/contributing-cli#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1 id="mesheryctl-system-context-delete">mesheryctl system context delete</h1>

<p>Delete context</p>

<h2 id="synopsis">Synopsis</h2>

<p>Delete an existing context (a named Meshery deployment) from Meshery config file</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system context delete [context-name] [flags]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="examples">Examples</h2>

<h3 id="delete-context">Delete context</h3>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system context delete [context name]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options">Options</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
  -h, --help         help for delete
  -s, --set string   New context to deploy Meshery

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">Options inherited from parent commands</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
      --config string    path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -c, --context string   (optional) temporarily change the current context.
  -v, --verbose          verbose output
  -y, --yes              (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="see-also">See Also</h2>

<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.8/project/contributing/contributing-cli#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>
   <br/>

$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1 id="mesheryctl-system-context">mesheryctl system context</h1>

<p>Configure your Meshery deployment(s)</p>

<h2 id="synopsis">Synopsis</h2>

<p>Configure and switch between different named Meshery server and component versions and deployments.</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system context [command] [flags]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="examples">Examples</h2>

<p>Base command</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system context

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options">Options</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
  -c, --context string   (optional) temporarily change the current context.
  -h, --help             help for context

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">Options inherited from parent commands</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -v, --verbose         verbose output
  -y, --yes             (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="see-also">See Also</h2>

<ul>
  <li><a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/system/context/create">mesheryctl system context create</a></li>
  <li><a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/system/context/delete">mesheryctl system context delete</a></li>
  <li><a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/system/context/list">mesheryctl system context list</a></li>
  <li><a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/system/context/switch">mesheryctl system context switch</a></li>
  <li><a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/system/context/view">mesheryctl system context view</a></li>
</ul>

              var parent = $("#" + div_id)

            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){

          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1 id="mesheryctl-system-context-list">mesheryctl system context list</h1>

<p>list contexts</p>

<h2 id="synopsis">Synopsis</h2>

<p>List current context and available contexts</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system context list [flags]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="examples">Examples</h2>

<p>List all contexts present</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system context list

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options">Options</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
  -h, --help   help for list

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">Options inherited from parent commands</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
      --config string    path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -c, --context string   (optional) temporarily change the current context.
  -v, --verbose          verbose output
  -y, --yes              (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="see-also">See Also</h2>

<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.8/project/contributing/contributing-cli#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>
   <br/>

<!-- <a href="http://idratherbewriting.com" class="noCrossRef productSubtitle"> Home </a> > <a class="noCrossRef productSubtitle" href="https://docs.meshery.io">Learn API Doc</a> > mesheryctl-system-context-switch -->

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1 id="mesheryctl-system-context-switch">mesheryctl system context switch</h1>

<p>switch context</p>

<h2 id="synopsis">Synopsis</h2>

<p>Configure mesheryctl to actively use one one context vs. another context</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system context switch context-name [flags]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="examples">Examples</h2>

<p>Switch to context named “sample”</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system context switch sample

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options">Options</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
  -h, --help   help for switch

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">Options inherited from parent commands</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
      --config string    path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -c, --context string   (optional) temporarily change the current context.
  -v, --verbose          verbose output
  -y, --yes              (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.

</div>
</pre>

          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }

            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1 id="mesheryctl-system-context-view">mesheryctl system context view</h1>

<p>Display the current Meshery CLI configuration context</p>

<h2 id="synopsis">Synopsis</h2>

<p>Display the current Meshery CLI context configuration.
This command shows which Kubernetes cluster, platform, and provider Meshery is configured to communicate with.
Use this to verify or debug your current CLI settings.</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system context view [context-name | --context context-name | --all] --flags [flags]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="examples">Examples</h2>

<p>View the default context</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system context view

</div>
</pre>

<p>View a specified context</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system context view context-name

</div>
</pre>

<p>View a specified context using the –context flag</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system context view --context context-name

</div>
</pre>

<p>View configuration of all contexts</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system context view --all

</div>
</pre>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
    

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options">Options</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
      --all              Show configs for all of the context
  -c, --context string   Show config for the context
  -h, --help             help for view

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">Options inherited from parent commands</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -v, --verbose         verbose output
  -y, --yes             (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="screenshots">Screenshots</h2>

<p>Usage of mesheryctl context view
<img src="/v0.8/assets/img/mesheryctl/context-view.png" alt="context-view-usage" /></p>

<h2 id="see-also">See Also</h2>

<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.8/project/contributing/contributing-cli#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1 id="mesheryctl-system-dashboard">mesheryctl system dashboard</h1>

<p>Open Meshery UI in browser.</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system dashboard [flags]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="examples">Examples</h2>

<p>Open Meshery UI in browser</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system dashboard

</div>
</pre>

<p>Open Meshery UI in browser and use port-forwarding (if default port is taken already)</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system dashboard --port-forward

</div>
</pre>

<p>Open Meshery UI in browser and use port-forwarding, listen on port 9081 locally, forwarding traffic to meshery server in the pod</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system dashboard --port-forward -p 9081

</div>
</pre>

<p>(optional) skip opening of MesheryUI in browser.</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system dashboard --skip-browser

</div>
</pre>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
Note: Meshery's web-based user interface is embedded in Meshery Server and is available as soon as Meshery starts. The location and port that Meshery UI is exposed varies depending upon your mode of deployment. See accessing \"Meshery UI\" for additional deployment-specific options: https://docs.meshery.io/installation/accessing-meshery-ui.

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options">Options</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
  -h, --help           help for dashboard
  -p, --port int       (optional) Local port that is not in use from which traffic is to be forwarded to the server running inside the Pod. (default 9081)
      --port-forward   (optional) Use port forwarding to access Meshery UI
      --skip-browser   (optional) skip opening of MesheryUI in browser.

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">Options inherited from parent commands</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
      --config string    path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -c, --context string   (optional) temporarily change the current context.
  -v, --verbose          verbose output
  -y, --yes              (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="see-also">See Also</h2>

<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.8/project/contributing/contributing-cli#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>
   <br/>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1 id="mesheryctl-system-delete">mesheryctl system delete</h1>

<p>Delete Meshery containers</p>

<h2 id="synopsis">Synopsis</h2>

<p>Delete Meshery containers. This command removes all Meshery containers created by docker-compose.</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system delete [flags]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="examples">Examples</h2>

<p>Delete Meshery containers</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system delete

</div>
</pre>

<p>Delete Meshery containers without confirmation</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system delete -y

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options">Options</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
  -h, --help   help for delete

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">Options inherited from parent commands</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
      --config string    path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -c, --context string   (optional) temporarily change the current context.
  -v, --verbose          verbose output
  -y, --yes              (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="see-also">See Also</h2>

<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.8/project/contributing/contributing-cli#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>
   <br/>

               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);

             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {

        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1 id="mesheryctl-system">mesheryctl system</h1>

<p>Configure, deploy, and operate Meshery deployments</p>

<h2 id="synopsis">Synopsis</h2>

<p>Manage the state and configuration of Meshery server, components, and client.</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system [flags]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options">Options</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
  -c, --context string   (optional) temporarily change the current context.
  -h, --help             help for system
  -y, --yes              (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">Options inherited from parent commands</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="see-also">See Also</h2>

<ul>
  <li><a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/system/channel">mesheryctl system channel</a></li>
  <li><a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/system/check">mesheryctl system check</a></li>
  <li><a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/system/context">mesheryctl system context</a></li>
  <li><a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/system/dashboard">mesheryctl system dashboard</a></li>
  <li><a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/system/delete">mesheryctl system delete</a></li>
  <li><a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/system/login">mesheryctl system login</a></li>
  <li><a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/system/logout">mesheryctl system logout</a></li>
  <li><a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/system/logs">mesheryctl system logs</a></li>
  <li><a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/system/provider">mesheryctl system provider</a></li>
  <li><a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/system/reset">mesheryctl system reset</a></li>
  <li><a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/system/restart">mesheryctl system restart</a></li>
  <li><a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/system/start">mesheryctl system start</a></li>
  <li><a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/system/status">mesheryctl system status</a></li>
  <li><a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/system/stop">mesheryctl system stop</a></li>
  <li><a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/system/token">mesheryctl system token</a></li>
  <li><a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/system/update">mesheryctl system update</a></li>
</ul>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1 id="mesheryctl-system-login">mesheryctl system login</h1>

<p>Authenticate to a Meshery Server</p>

<h2 id="synopsis">Synopsis</h2>

<p>Authenticate to the Local or a Remote Provider of a Meshery Server</p>

<p>The authentication mode is web-based browser flow</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system login [flags]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="examples">Examples</h2>

<p>Login with the Meshery Provider of your choice: the Local Provider or a Remote Provider.</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system login

</div>
</pre>

<p>Login with the Meshery Provider by specifying it via -p or –provider flag.</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system login -p Meshery

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options">Options</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
  -h, --help              help for login
  -p, --provider string   login Meshery with specified provider

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">Options inherited from parent commands</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
      --config string    path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -c, --context string   (optional) temporarily change the current context.
  -v, --verbose          verbose output
  -y, --yes              (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="see-also">See Also</h2>

<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.8/project/contributing/contributing-cli#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>
   <br/>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1 id="mesheryctl-system-logout">mesheryctl system logout</h1>

<p>Remove authentication for Meshery Server</p>

<h2 id="synopsis">Synopsis</h2>

<p>Remove authentication for Meshery Server</p>

<p>This command removes the authentication token from the user’s filesystem</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system logout [flags]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="examples">Examples</h2>

<p>Logout current session with your Meshery Provider.</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system logout

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options">Options</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
  -h, --help   help for logout

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">Options inherited from parent commands</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
      --config string    path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -c, --context string   (optional) temporarily change the current context.
  -v, --verbose          verbose output
  -y, --yes              (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="see-also">See Also</h2>

<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.8/project/contributing/contributing-cli#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>
   <br/>


        </div>
      </main>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1 id="mesheryctl-system-logs">mesheryctl system logs</h1>

<p>Print logs</p>

<h2 id="synopsis">Synopsis</h2>

<p>Print history of Meshery’s logs and begin tailing them.</p>

<p>It also shows the logs of a specific component.</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system logs [flags]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="examples">Examples</h2>

<p>Show logs (without tailing)</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system logs

</div>
</pre>

<p>Starts tailing Meshery server debug logs (works with components also)</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system logs --follow

</div>
</pre>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system logs meshery-istio

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options">Options</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
  -f, --follow   (Optional) Follow the stream of the Meshery's logs. Defaults to false.
  -h, --help     help for logs

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">Options inherited from parent commands</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
      --config string    path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -c, --context string   (optional) temporarily change the current context.
  -v, --verbose          verbose output
  -y, --yes              (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="see-also">See Also</h2>

<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.8/project/contributing/contributing-cli#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1 id="mesheryctl-system-provider">mesheryctl system provider</h1>

<p>Switch between providers</p>

<h2 id="synopsis">Synopsis</h2>

<p>Enforce a provider. Choose between available Meshery providers</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system provider [flags]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="examples">Examples</h2>

<p>To view provider</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system provider view

</div>
</pre>

<p>To list all available providers</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system provider list

</div>
</pre>

<p>To set a provider</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system provider set [provider]

</div>
</pre>

<p>To switch provider and redeploy Meshery</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system provider switch [provider]

</div>
</pre>

<p>To clear the configured provider</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system provider reset

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options">Options</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
  -h, --help   help for provider

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">Options inherited from parent commands</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
      --config string    path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -c, --context string   (optional) temporarily change the current context.
  -v, --verbose          verbose output
  -y, --yes              (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="see-also">See Also</h2>

<ul>
  <li><a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/system/provider/list">mesheryctl system provider list</a></li>
  <li><a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/system/provider/reset">mesheryctl system provider reset</a></li>
  <li><a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/system/provider/set">mesheryctl system provider set</a></li>
  <li><a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/system/provider/switch">mesheryctl system provider switch</a></li>
  <li><a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/system/provider/view">mesheryctl system provider view</a></li>
</ul>

<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.8/project/contributing/contributing-cli#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>

$(document).ready(function() {

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1 id="mesheryctl-system-provider-list">mesheryctl system provider list</h1>

<p>list available providers</p>

<h2 id="synopsis">Synopsis</h2>

<p>List current provider and available providers</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system provider list [flags]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="examples">Examples</h2>

<p>List all available providers</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system provider list

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options">Options</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">

$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1 id="mesheryctl-system-provider-reset">mesheryctl system provider reset</h1>

<p>Clear the configured provider</p>

<h2 id="synopsis">Synopsis</h2>

<p>Clear the configured provider for the current context. This allows users to select a provider on the next Meshery start. This clears the enforced provider so that users are presented with the provider selection UI on next start.</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system provider reset [flags]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="examples">Examples</h2>

<p>Clear the configured provider</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system provider reset

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options">Options</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
  -h, --help   help for reset

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">Options inherited from parent commands</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
      --config string    path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -c, --context string   (optional) temporarily change the current context.
  -v, --verbose          verbose output
  -y, --yes              (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="see-also">See Also</h2>

<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.8/project/contributing/contributing-cli#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>
   <br/>

    // Select each header

        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {

            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1 id="mesheryctl-system-provider-set">mesheryctl system provider set</h1>

<p>set provider</p>

<h2 id="synopsis">Synopsis</h2>

<p>Set provider of context in focus. Run <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl system provider list</code> to see the available providers.</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system provider set [provider] [flags]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="examples">Examples</h2>

<p>Set provider</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system provider set [provider]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options">Options</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
  -f, --force   Force set provider
  -h, --help    help for set

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">Options inherited from parent commands</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
      --config string    path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -c, --context string   (optional) temporarily change the current context.
  -v, --verbose          verbose output
  -y, --yes              (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="see-also">See Also</h2>

<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.8/project/contributing/contributing-cli#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>
   <br/>


        </div>

              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");

          // Loop through every navigation menu item

              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');

          }

          }

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1 id="mesheryctl-system-provider-switch">mesheryctl system provider switch</h1>

<p>switch provider and redeploy</p>

<h2 id="synopsis">Synopsis</h2>

<p>Switch provider of context in focus and redeploy Meshery. Run <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl system provider list</code> to see the available providers.</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system provider switch [provider] [flags]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="examples">Examples</h2>

<p>Switch provider and redeploy Meshery</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system provider switch [provider]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options">Options</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
  -h, --help   help for switch

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">Options inherited from parent commands</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
      --config string    path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -c, --context string   (optional) temporarily change the current context.
  -v, --verbose          verbose output
  -y, --yes              (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="see-also">See Also</h2>

<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.8/project/contributing/contributing-cli#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>
   <br/>

});
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1 id="mesheryctl-system-provider-view">mesheryctl system provider view</h1>

<p>view provider</p>

<h2 id="synopsis">Synopsis</h2>

<p>View provider of context in focus</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system provider view [flags]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="examples">Examples</h2>

<p>View current provider</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system provider view

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options">Options</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
  -a, --all    Show provider for all contexts
  -h, --help   help for view

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">Options inherited from parent commands</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
      --config string    path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -c, --context string   (optional) temporarily change the current context.
  -v, --verbose          verbose output
  -y, --yes              (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="see-also">See Also</h2>

<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.8/project/contributing/contributing-cli#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>
   <br/>


        </div>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1 id="mesheryctl-system-reset">mesheryctl system reset</h1>

<p>Reset Meshery’s configuration</p>

<h2 id="synopsis">Synopsis</h2>

<p>Reset Meshery to it’s default configuration.</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system reset [flags]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="examples">Examples</h2>

<p>Resets meshery.yaml file with a copy from Meshery repo</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system reset

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options">Options</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
  -h, --help   help for reset

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">Options inherited from parent commands</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
      --config string    path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -c, --context string   (optional) temporarily change the current context.
  -v, --verbose          verbose output
  -y, --yes              (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="screenshots">Screenshots</h2>

<p>Usage of mesheryctl system reset
<img src="/v0.8/assets/img/mesheryctl/reset.png" alt="reset-usage" /></p>

<h2 id="see-also">See Also</h2>

<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.8/project/contributing/contributing-cli#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1 id="mesheryctl-system-restart">mesheryctl system restart</h1>

<p>Stop, then start Meshery</p>

<h2 id="synopsis">Synopsis</h2>

<p>Restart all Meshery containers / pods.</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system restart [flags]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="examples">Examples</h2>

<p>Restart all Meshery containers, their instances and their connected volumes</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system restart

</div>
</pre>

<p>(optional) skip checking for new updates available in Meshery.</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system restart --skip-update

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options">Options</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
  -h, --help              help for restart
      --provider string   Provider to use with the Meshery server
      --skip-update       (optional) skip checking for new Meshery's container images.

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">Options inherited from parent commands</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
      --config string    path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -c, --context string   (optional) temporarily change the current context.
  -v, --verbose          verbose output
  -y, --yes              (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="see-also">See Also</h2>

<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.8/project/contributing/contributing-cli#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>
   <br/>

$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1 id="mesheryctl-system-start">mesheryctl system start</h1>

<p>Start Meshery</p>

<h2 id="synopsis">Synopsis</h2>

<p>Start Meshery and each of its cloud native components.</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system start [flags]

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="examples">Examples</h2>

<p>Start meshery</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system start

</div>
</pre>

<p>(optional) skip opening of MesheryUI in browser.</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system start --skip-browser

</div>
</pre>

<p>(optional) skip checking for new updates available in Meshery.</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system start --skip-update

</div>
</pre>

<p>Reset Meshery’s configuration file to default settings.</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system start --reset

</div>
</pre>

<p>Specify Platform to deploy Meshery to.</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system start -p docker

</div>
</pre>

<p>Specify Provider to use.</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
mesheryctl system start --provider Meshery

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options">Options</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
  -h, --help              help for start
  -p, --platform string   platform to deploy Meshery to.
      --provider string   (optional) Defaults to the provider specified in the current context
      --reset             (optional) reset Meshery's configuration file to default settings.
      --skip-browser      (optional) skip opening of MesheryUI in browser.
      --skip-update       (optional) skip checking for new Meshery's container images.

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">Options inherited from parent commands</h2>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock">
      --config string    path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -c, --context string   (optional) temporarily change the current context.
  -v, --verbose          verbose output
  -y, --yes              (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.

</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="see-also">See Also</h2>

<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.8/project/contributing/contributing-cli#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>
   <br/>

$(document).ready(function() {
